'''Carp Surprise''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

'''Note''': this recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - it will result in profit when using the lowest quality ingredients.  Turning the [[Carp]] into [[Sashimi]] will be even more profitable, however.

Carp Surprise may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. One Carp Surprise may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].

==Bundles==
Carp Surprise is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Carp Surprise is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Carp Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt250.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Carp Surprise is not used in any [[quests]].
